'''Kangjian''' is an NPC in {{Location|Lake Heights}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the day)
:'''Kangjian:''' Sorry, I was just asking [[Po'xiao|this friend]] to help me write a eulogy for my fallen comrade...
:{{DIcon}} Sorry if I bothered you...
:'''Kangjian:''' No worries, it's over now. Are you here to visit an old friend?
:{{DIcon}} And you?
:'''Kangjian:''' Yeah, I come here every day to pay my respects to my comrades who fell to the [[Tacet Discord]]s and the [[Exiles]].
:'''Kangjian:''' Though often filled with hatred and anger, I stand here as just a broken shell.
:'''Kangjian:''' The fingers on my injured hand are useless... Can't even hold a pen to write. How pathetic.

;(During the evening)
:'''Kangjian:''' [[Tuanjin]] is a good kid. She's always here helping out and looking after us.
:'''Kangjian:''' Everyone likes her, but it's hard for them to express their gratitude.
:{{DIcon}} Are you thankful to her, too?
:'''Kangjian:''' Of course, just don't let her know. She'd probably get all embarrassed.
{{Dialogue End}}
